# Packaging, CI & Release Automation Quality Checklist: Phase 7

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned quality and completeness checklist validating requirements for standard Python packaging, multi-platform CI matrix testing, artifact validation, and release automation.  
**Created**: 2026-10-02  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Packaging & Distribution Metadata Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are package discovery directives explicitly defined (`tool.setuptools.packages.find`) to include `f2m*` and exclude documentation, tests, and assets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Plan §1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the top-level execution wrapper `f2m.py` explicitly declared via `py-modules` to support dual invocation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan §1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are runtime dependencies strictly limited to `beautifulsoup4>=4.11.0` and `rich>=13.0.0` without extraneous dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are development and packaging tools (`pytest`, `ruff`, `build`, `twine`) separated under `[project.optional-dependencies] dev`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Is Python compatibility specified as `requires-python = ">=3.8"` with supported version range clearly identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a single authoritative version source defined in `pyproject.toml` with synchronization rules for in-code constants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Tasks T006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are wheel and source distribution (`sdist`) generation requirements specified with metadata validation (`twine check --strict`)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]

---

## 2. CLI Console Script & Installation Quality

- [ ] CHK008 Is the console script entry point `f2m` mapped to a zero-argument callable (`f2m:main`) under `[project.scripts]`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §2]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the specification require identical execution behavior between the installed `f2m` command and `python f2m.py`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract §1.1]
- [ ] CHK010 Are clean-environment wheel installation smoke tests specified (`f2m --version`, `f2m help`) to catch missing package modules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Tasks T010]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification guarantee that all Phase 4 commands, formatters (`--json`, `--plain`, `--no-color`), and exit codes function identically via `f2m`? [Consistency, Spec §6]
- [ ] CHK012 Are Phase 5 Rich presentation and Phase 6 unprivileged downloader behaviors preserved under console script execution? [Consistency, Spec §6]

---

## 3. GitHub Actions CI Pipeline Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are CI workflow trigger events explicitly defined for `push` to `master` and all `pull_request` events targeting `master`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Contract §2.1]
- [ ] CHK014 Is a multi-Python matrix specified covering Python 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12 on `ubuntu-latest`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Is cross-platform operating system verification specified on `macos-latest` and `windows-latest`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Are code quality gates (linting with `ruff check .` and syntax compilation) mandated in the CI pipeline? [Completeness, Tasks T020]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the CI pipeline mandate executing the entire automated test suite (105+ tests) in offline mode with zero regressions? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 Is a package integrity gate specified that builds artifacts with `build`, checks metadata with `twine`, and tests clean installation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Tasks T022]

---

## 4. Release Automation & Supply Chain Security

- [ ] CHK019 Is release workflow execution strictly restricted to tag pushes matching `v*` and explicitly prohibited on untrusted pull requests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Research §5]
- [ ] CHK020 Are top-level workflow permissions scoped according to least privilege (`contents: read` default, `contents: write` only for release job)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Contract §3.1]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the release workflow build and attach wheel (`.whl`), sdist (`.tar.gz`), and standalone PyInstaller binaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK022 Are cryptographic SHA-256 checksums (`SHA256SUMS.txt`) required to be generated and published alongside all release assets? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Contract §3.2]
- [ ] CHK023 Is PyPI publishing intentionally omitted or deferred to prevent unnecessary exposure of long-lived publishing tokens? [Consistency, Spec §5, Clarifications #22]

---

## 5. Bilingual Documentation Parity & Maintenance

- [ ] CHK024 Are documentation requirements specified for updating `README.md` with package installation instructions (`pip install .`, `pipx`) and virtual environment setup? [Completeness, Tasks T031]
- [ ] CHK025 Are documentation requirements specified for updating `README.fa.md` in full parity with English packaging instructions? [Consistency, Constitution Principle V, Tasks T032]
- [ ] CHK026 Are supported Python versions (3.8–3.12) and offline development test commands documented in both languages? [Completeness, Tasks T031, T032]

---

## 6. Scope Discipline & Architectural Preservation

- [ ] CHK027 Does the specification strictly prohibit unrelated product features, UI redesigns, scraper alterations, or downloader refactoring? [Completeness, Spec §5, Constitution Principle IX]
- [ ] CHK028 Are all completed behaviors and architectural contracts from Phases 1 through 6 preserved without regression? [Consistency, Spec §6]

---
